summary.text: Will Bruck (listed by Ballotpedia as William Bruck) is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 30 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a U.S. Army veteran and former business owner.

paragraphs.text: William Bruck was born in Michigan and earned a B.A. in Biblical studies from Northland Baptist Bible College in 1998 and an M.B.A. from Columbia Southern University in 2014.
He has served in the U.S. Army for more than 30 years and has reached the rank of chief warrant officer 4.
Bruck's career experience includes owning Visiting Angels of Toledo, Ohio, and Visiting Angels Monroe, Michigan, and working as a journeyman lineman with IBEW Local #17.
He has served on the Monroe County Community College Board of Trustees.
Bruck assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session he sits on the House Oversight and Transportation committees.
